newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close 2.73 pct down in bearish market.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close 2.73 pct down in bearish market.

text.p: Dhaka shares slumped further at the close on Wednesday as selling pressure mounted, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all share price index fell 92.88 points or 2.73 percent at 3,298.04. Tunrover dropped to 166.4 million taka. Of the 103 traded issues, 89 lost and 14 rose.
Apex Foods fell 954.02 taka to 18,125.34 while Shine Pukur Holdings edged up 33.31 to 718.41. --Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
